instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Use 'recharts' for data visualization.
2. LAYOUT: Implement the 'Control Room Grid' (Mode B). Use 'grid-cols-12' with tight gaps (gap-4).
3. STYLE: Force DARK MODE. There is no light mode. Hardcode dark colors if necessary or set 'dark' class on html/body.
4. FONTS: Import Chivo, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.css.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to remove rounded corners ('rounded-none') and increase border contrast.
6. ANIMATION: Use 'framer-motion' for the 'Live Traffic' feed. Items should slide in from the top.
7. DATA: Mock the real-time data stream. Create a hook 'useTrafficStream' that emits a new log every 500ms-2000ms.
8. DASHBOARD: The main view should have: (A) Global Status Header, (B) Live Traffic Feed (Terminal style), (C) Threat Map (Grid/Chart), (D) Stats Cards.
9. LOGS: The Threat Log table must use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data cells. Use color-coded badges for ALLOW/BLOCK/FLAG.
10. BLACKLIST: A simple management view to add/remove IPs manually.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds, use solid dark colors or subtle noise textures.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numbers and data.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (brightness-110 or border color change).
